title: The card reads a family from an outcome recorded in other words, where it read none
request: S9.4 live replay: four people stopped at the family question after 'I don't know'; two of them were understood by Claude as clustering.
plan: Only where the card read no family and nothing is in play, and the outcome is recorded in words that are not a column and not the person's own.
Read those words as an answer to the family question is read (the reader's families reach the card the same way).

decisions.decision: Never over a reading: only a card with no family changes.
decisions.why: The understanding rules are measured (journeys, sealed sets); a change that can only unblock keeps every measured reading.

change: draft/card.py card_of: the outcome words read with dclab_core.conversation.read_answer('family') when the card read none; tests/test_home_not_known.py.

findings.defect: An outcome recorded as 'no outcome, clustering' left the card without a family.
findings.scenario: JH-segmentation-000 and -003, Claude's arm of S9.4: the card waited on 'What should DCLab give for each row?', the person said they did not know, nothing was built.
findings.cause: card_of read the family from the person's words only; the model's recorded outcome was never read for one.
findings.fix: Read the recorded outcome's words for a family only where the card read none.
findings.open: embedded-007 (a column named in quotes) and forecasting-008 (an outcome recorded as one word) stay: other findings

measurements.name: the four blocked drafts of S9.4, read again
measurements.gate: the kept drafts of the live replay, no model called
measurements.result: segmentation-000 and -003 now read segmentation; embedded-007 and forecasting-008 still none

measurements.name: harness-eval and the card suites
measurements.gate: 17 journeys step by step; 16 test files

outcome: A model's reading of a problem with no outcome now reaches the card when nothing else did.
lessons: A fix that can only turn 'unknown' into a reading is the safe kind for a measured rule set.
risks: A paraphrase read as a family the person did not mean: the meet check and the card's confirmation still stand.
